title: Lesotho Flour Mills drivers’ stoppage over workplace facilities
date: 2021-02-05 article; first stoppage date not established
reason: Search-only evidence describes a private employer dispute over workplace toilets, taps and showers and does not establish a public gathering, a 50-person crowd, or a demand directed to the Lesotho state. Keep excluded from confirmed public-event coding pending further evidence.
notes: Newsday search-result material says the stoppage was called off after a remedy was agreed. The body was not opened. See gap lesotho_2021-02-G007.

title: COLEPE petition delivered to the Prime Minister
date: 2021-02-22 (delivery date reported in a 2022 State Department search excerpt)
reason: The available search excerpt reports a petition delivery seeking salary and tax changes but does not establish a public march or assembly of at least 50. Petition delivery alone is not coded as a qualifying public gathering.
notes: The underlying report was not read; public attendance and any linked rally remain unknown. See gap lesotho_2021-02-G006.
